content_sections.heading: About KAU Assistant Professor (Contract) Agronomy
content_sections.text: The post is advertised by the Cocoa Research Centre of Kerala Agricultural University, located at Vellanikkara, KAU P.O, Thrissur - 680656. The Assistant Professor (Contract) will work in the "Mondelez-KAU Collaborative Cocoa Research Project" of this centre. The notice is signed by Dr. Minimol J.S., Professor & Head, CRC.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Kerala Agricultural University has one vacancy of Assistant Professor (Contract) in the discipline of Agronomy. The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs.44,100/- per month. The candidate will have no claim in the University other than the consolidated remuneration attached to the post. Essential: M.Sc. in Agronomy with NET qualification. Applicants should have masters degree in the concerned discipline recognized by Kerala Agricultural University with a minimum of 55 % marks and NET qualification. Ph.D and teaching/research experience in the discipline considered. Experience in relevant field. The age of the applicant should not be above 50 years as on 1 January 2026. Age relaxation as per existing government rules will be granted to eligible candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application form is to be downloaded in 'Microsoft Excel' format from the website www.kau.in and brought as a hard copy at the time of interview. The interview section of the notice refers to the filled-in application "in attached word format". The application must contain self-attested copies of proof for age, caste, qualification and experience. The notice lists these documents to be presented at the interview: Duly filled-in application form, with self attested copies of certificates and marklists and photograph affixed. Aadhar Card/Photo ID card of the candidate. Originals of all the relevant documents listed below. Certificate to prove date of birth (SSLC/Equivalent), Degree certificate, Degree mark list, Post graduate degree certificate, Post graduate degree mark list, Certificate of NET, and certificates of additional qualifications such as Ph.D. Certificate of experience in related field, if any. Scientific publications, other trainings and certifications in the field, if any.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration of candidates begins at 9.30 am on 24 November 2026; the notice prints the interview time as 9.00 am on the same day. Candidates appear for the interview with the filled-in application form. Original certificates should be produced for verification. No separate call letter will be sent to the applicants. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment will be purely provisional up to 28-2-2027, till the end of the project. The appointment will not confer any right of permanency or regularisation in KAU. If selected for appointment, the candidate must execute an agreement in the prescribed form on Stamp paper worth Rs. 200/-. The selected candidate will discharge all duties attached to the post as per KAU Act/Statutes/Regulation & Rules and those assigned from time to time by the Head of Institution/Departments. Cocoa Research Centre, Vellanikkara, Kerala Agricultural University has the right to terminate the temporary appointment if the performance is found unsatisfactory or any such defects are noticed. For further information, contact 0487-2438451 or email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the KAU Assistant Professor (Contract) Agronomy walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted on 24 November 2026 at the Cocoa Research Centre, Vellanikkara, Kerala Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Registration of candidates is at 9.30 am on 24 November 2026; the notice prints the interview time as 9.00 am on the same day.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Assistant Professor (Contract) in Agronomy.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. in Agronomy with NET qualification, a masters degree recognized by Kerala Agricultural University with a minimum of 55% marks. Ph.D and teaching/research experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant should not be above 50 years of age as on 1 January 2026, with age relaxation as per existing government rules for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of KAU Assistant Professor (Contract) Agronomy?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs.44,100/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the filled-in application form with self-attested copies and photograph, Aadhar Card/Photo ID card, and originals of date-of-birth, degree, post graduate, NET and additional qualification certificates, plus experience certificates and publications, if any.

faq.question: Q8. How will the candidate be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview on 24 November 2026, where original certificates should be produced for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely provisional up to 28-2-2027, till the end of the project, and confers no right of permanency or regularisation in KAU.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.
